# Body-derived effect first-source study

Twenty informed desired/control/counterexample programs precede implementation
of #315. The first source/manifest map is `first-files.json`; observations are
appended to `session.json` without replacing original sources or results.
Current diagnostic acceptance and eventual inferred metadata, independently
specified small numerical action and formal preservation remain separate facts.

The typed effect analysis must retain exact source types, ownership, all arms,
capability checks and termination. The three existing effects describe quantum
action at fixed ordinary inputs. An annotation is a checked upper bound, and
the displayed/exported principal classification comes from the checked body.
No stdlib/path/name privilege or external-contract escape hatch is permitted.

The approved QS/PR/RS and EXACT obligations, both scoped QLV1 guarantees and
all remaining 110-Issue criteria retain their scope. This study discharges
no new guarantee and does not itself complete #315.
